SELECT
  AVG(invoice_mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
FROM (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(product_price) AS invoice_mean_product_price,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
